'''Pharshol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] and was buried within the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] centuries ago. In life, he oversaw the construction of the Dark Temple. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], his spirit was disturbed and settled within a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] workman. Gaining complete control over his host body, Pharshol was unaware of any time passing between his death and the current period but retained all the abilities and memories of his previous life. Upon awakening within the workman, he immediately set about trying to recover his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anyarah]] from the [[Dark Force|Dark Path]], which he was convinced she had joined.
